title: AttemptClaim
description: Claim of one batch job or agent attempt through the guarded API, before any work starts (OQ-05 section 4, OQ-03 section 5). The worker sends the claim form. The API answers with the grant form, or with api-error/1 when the attempt is stale, terminal or claimed by another worker. The lease and ownership revision are separate from any queue receipt.

AttemptClaimRequest.title: AttemptClaimRequest
AttemptClaimRequest.description: dispatch_digest is the digest of the job-dispatch/1 or agent-dispatch/1 the worker received. worker_id is recorded for diagnosis and grants no authority.

AttemptClaimGrant.title: AttemptClaimGrant
AttemptClaimGrant.description: The worker now owns the attempt until lease_expires_at. capability is an attempt-scoped credential for the input, artefact and result routes of this attempt only; it expires with the lease. Only the current owner can complete.

AttemptCapability.title: AttemptCapability
AttemptCapability.description: Opaque bearer token. It is never logged or stored in evidence.
